errors.evidence: The description identifies the color of the largest sector ('1 Силно съгласен; 44%') as 'blue-dark blue'. The sector is light blue, while another, smaller sector ('5 Силно несъгласен; 1%') is dark blue, making the description inaccurate and potentially confusing.

The description claims the labels are located inside the sectors. In fact, four of the five labels are located outside their respective sectors, with lines pointing to them. Only one label is inside its sector.
